# pg_corpus_raster.txt -- surfaces S1 (Segmento), S2 (bbox gate),
#                        S3 (poly3d drawb: degenerate row, edge stroking, fill)
#
# FROZEN FIXTURE.  Generated by pg_mkcorpus.py; do not edit either copy
# by hand -- regenerate.  Neither implementer may change it; a change is
# a coordinator commit.
#
# ORDER IS PART OF THE FIXTURE.  Both sides consume the rows in file
# order.  Rows with pre=PRE3 (carry) take the PREVIOUS row's OUTPUT page
# as their input page, so reordering changes the expected result.
#
# PAGE MODEL.  The page is 65540 units indexed j = 0..65539 from the
# segment origin.  adapted[i] is unit j = 4+i, because farmalloc returns
# offset 4 (BUFFERMAP 4.1) and `adapted` is `unsigned char far *`
# (NOCTIS-0.CPP:54).  Units j=0..3 lie BELOW adapted[0]; nothing in
# Wave 6a may write them.
#
# PRE-STATES (formulas over j, not blobs):
#   PRE0  page[j] = 0
#   PRE1  page[j] = (j*101) & 255
#   PRE2  page[j] = 0 except adapted[k]=255 for k in
#         {32040,32041,32042,32043,32044,32060,32360,48005,48311,60999}
#   PRE3  carry: the previous case's output page
#
# GRAMMAR
#   SEG  <id> xp= yp= xa= ya= pre=
#   BBOX <id> n= mp=x0,y0;x1,y1;...
#   FILL <id> n= mp=... bbox=minx,maxx,miny,maxy colore= flares= entity= pre=
#
# The FILL bbox is a SEPARATE pinned input, not derived from that row's
# mp[].  The original computes the bbox from the PRE-clip vertices and
# never recomputes it, so for any clipped polygon the two are
# inconsistent by construction -- see class CLIPPED_BBOX.

# --- S1 Segmento ---
SEG SEG_VERT_DOWN xp=100 yp=20 xa=100 ya=40 pre=PRE0

# SHARED: two triangles sharing an edge, drawn in sequence.  This is the
# class the game runs every frame and the one most likely to be absent
# from a hand-written corpus.  The second takes the first's output page.
FILL SHARED_A n=3 mp=60,40;200,40;60,150 bbox=60,200,40,150 colore=22 flares=0 entity=1 pre=PRE0
FILL SHARED_B n=3 mp=200,40;200,150;60,150 bbox=60,200,40,150 colore=23 flares=0 entity=1 pre=PRE3

# CLIPPED_BBOX: mp[] is post-clip, bbox is from the PRE-clip vertices, so
